summary: Capture and check the return value of FileInputStream.read() in the bad() method. Previously the number of bytes read was discarded, so the code blindly treated a full 1024-byte buffer as valid data even when fewer bytes (or -1 at EOF) were returned. Now the return value is stored and used to decode only the bytes actually read, and EOF is handled, preserving the file-reading feature while eliminating the unchecked return value.
